intro: Elder Starweave is an ancestral night elf spirit honored during the Lunar Festival. Found resting at the port town of Auberdine along the misty coast of Darkshore, she shares the wisdom of ancient ages with passing pilgrims.

p: Appearing as an ethereal shade among the coastal dwellings of Auberdine, Elder Starweave is one of the revered ancestors honored by the Cenarion Circle and the peoples of Kalimdor. While many travelers rush through the port on their way inland or across the sea, those who pause before her receive an ancestral blessing. Starweave speaks of celestial movements, observing that the stars of the modern era trace unfamiliar paths that serve as beacons of hope and fortitude for future generations.
